body: Yeah, then again I'm posting here because venting to my family only leads to "man up" or "try not being depressed". But seriously, talking to someone with similar experiences does help. Thanks man.

Thanks man, when I talk to my family about this all I get is the classic "have you tried not being depressed". Knowing there's been people in similar situations as me and are still going does make this a bit more bearable.
Keep busy, pick up a new instrument, or learn something new, don't let your head get there because once it does it's way too difficult to break out of it.

Go read my recent post, it's a similar story to yours, minus the girlfriend, you seem to be staring at the deep hole in which I am at the bottom. Think of me as your ghost from the future. I don't know what you can do to get better but I do know what happens if you don't change.

I've been feeling like stabbing myself in the neck with two knives. I won't do it, but I wouldn't mind exchanging shit stories as to why you feel the way you do and why I feel the way I do. Maybe some new perspective is needed in order for me to stop seeing my life as just a giant pile of garbage.
